cells.name: E-10 slider own release
cells.line: Tab out of the engaged slider: ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0047 (the reference for the hand-off and Escape bounds)

cells.name: E-10 slider escape release
cells.line: Escape: ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0049 (bound ≤ own release 0.0047 + 0.002)

cells.name: E-10 slider re-render landing
cells.line: a sibling inserted during the hold, then release: the root's largest one-frame move per 16.7 ms 40.0 px (without the insert 0.9 px; bound ≤ that + 1 px)

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off drop
cells.line: Tab A → B (focus on ProbeB): A ×1.060 → ×1.000, largest one-frame drop per 16.7 ms 0.0047 (bound ≤ A's own release 0.0047 + 0.002) · B ×1.000 → ×1.060

cells.name: E-10 slider2 hand-off veil
cells.line: veil 1.00 before the Tab, minimum 1.00 across the hand-off, 1.00 at the end (bound ≥ 0.1× its level: it does not re-ramp from 0)
